name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A ring that spins while work runs and closes into a drawn check or cross when it ends.
whenToUse: Short indeterminate work tied to one row, button or step.

keyboard: role=status while loading; role=img with Done/Failed after.
spec.motion: The loading ring rotates while visible; managed/OS reduction holds the ring still. Success/error retains a meaningful shape and label; draw and arc use semantic timings.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style target the visual root; typed classNames reach internal parts. Native refs preserve focus, measurement and existing state. Actual-host motion policy and timings are resolved without recreating state. Managed reduced/none and OS reduction stop decorative loops/displacement; continuous effects pause offscreen or in a hidden document.

review.notes: Turn on the compositor; result drawn as a shape; pulses under reduced motion.

notes: The 0.8s loader turn is multiplied by the nearest motion speed and look factor. Managed/OS reduction holds it still; offscreen/hidden pauses it. Arc closing and mark drawing use duration/ease tokens.
